'''Valorsi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Valorsi system/Legends|Valorsi system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Its native inhabitants, who came from many [[Species/Legends|species]], were known as Valorsians. Spacers told rumors of the pleasure world, which was said to have something to please even the most depraved lusts. The world's harems, where beings of both [[Gender/Legends|sexes]] and of innumerable species were kept and carefully bred for their beauty, were whispered about in taverns across the galaxy.<ref name="TEA" /> Valorsian harems were rumored to be carefully guarded.<ref name="POT" /> Only high-ranking [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] from the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex and Juvex]] houses and their attendants could travel to the world.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Valorsians are mentioned in a comment by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', a novel by [[Barbara Hambly]], first published in [[1997]]. From the context, it is unclear whether "Valorsian" refers to a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] (much like "[[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]" or "[[Hapan]]"), or some other [[organization]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', by [[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], clarifies that the term refers to the world Valorsi, whose populace is composed of sentients from many species.<ref name="TEA" />
